# Vennova Clinic Management System

> Vennova is a clinic operating system for homeopathic and general practices — patient records, live queue, consultations, prescriptions, billing and follow-up reminders in one place.

Most of the application is behind a staff login. The pages below are the public entry points.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Vennova clinic management system.
- [Sign in](/auth): Clinic owner registration and staff sign-in.
